decisions.decision: New operation member belongs in API; do not introduce a Core-to-API dependency or a new public type/marker factory.
Only the existing public compatible identity profile returns Supported; live operations in other profiles return Unsupported after callback-free engine checks.
An invalid/plain/foreign/rebound carrier in the selected profile raises its original argument error; current proof/availability/cancellation errors propagate rather than being recast as false.
The result is a borrowed guarded ISchemaAtomicProvenance, not a detached tuple, authority token, IPC payload or independent native lease.
Declared/actual/origin are original source metadata under the current compatible execution admission, never fabricated target authority identities.

Validate through the current TypedOperation issuer and exact target snapshot/cache/representation; preserve existing singleton/non-list string/boolean/integer/decimal restrictions and captured limits.
Each getter opens the same raw operation serialized provider-pair window, validates the carrier/episode before reading and guards delivery afterwards.

Use the positive proof established for this raw operation and recheck its existing current endpoints/source/authority guards; do not add a new Establish per getter or extend a proof into another raw operation.
Store no provenance views or old issuers in the stable payload registry. Stable scalar identity and SchemaAtomics.TryGetProvenance compatible false/null remain unchanged.
Raw closure/cancellation invalidates every getter; late calls must refuse before provider callbacks. Holding/dropping a view does not keep/release native admissions.
Actual in-flight getters retain provider/source resources through their real call tails; canceled observer waits do not release early.
Overlapping/reentrant getter work in one operation refuses under existing provider serialization; independent operation views never borrow each other's episode.
No new scalar/source slot or user workload default is selected. Measure bounded caller allocations/latency/callbacks without claiming owner budgets.
Existing work/release failure identity and reverse cleanup order remain unchanged; observation does not flatten or swallow provider aggregates.
The added signature needs owner/final manifest acceptance; 47 type names do not imply all member/semantic requirements are closed.
General containers, private legacy disposition, actual native/owner/performance and release gates remain explicit open work.
